record.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。The paper parallelizes nonlinear RNN evaluation using quasi-Newton methods. Sequence experiments include a case where quasi-ELK takes 221 ms versus 96 ms sequentially; this is architecture-specific and does not show a speedup for transformer/LLM inference.
record.title: Towards Scalable and Stable Parallelization of Nonlinear RNNs
